subject.title: [Feature]: Control console session list should show full date

question: Should the Sessions Updated column switch from relative text to direct full date/time, and should maintainers adopt the open fork pull request or replace it with a fresh same-repo implementation?
rationale: The source-level gap is clear, but the exact timestamp display is user-facing UX policy and the only open implementation candidate is a conflicting fork pull request.

options.title: Adopt full date/time display
options.body: Proceed with a narrow local full date/time display, preserving localized fallback and relative hover context, by rebasing the fork or replacing it in the target repository.

options.title: Keep compact relative display
options.body: Decline the full-date UX request and close the linked implementation path if maintainers prefer compact relative Updated values in the session list.

options.title: Fold into broader Sessions UX
options.body: Keep this as part of a larger Sessions table redesign if maintainers do not want a one-off column-format change now.

recommendation.title: Adopt full date/time display
recommendation.body: Proceed with a narrow local full date/time display, preserving localized fallback and relative hover context, by rebasing the fork or replacing it in the target repository.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current-main history on the Sessions page and recent Control UI table behavior.
